dataset.compatibility_note: ADDITIONAL PUBLIC dataset for external validation/training of change detection — explicitly NOT an SIH26167-prescribed dataset. Provides semantic change masks (from-to land-cover). The current deterministic detector produces BINARY radiometric change only; using SECOND for binary change requires collapsing semantic labels to changed/unchanged (a documented, lossy conversion). A learned semantic detector would be a new component; the Phase 6 detector is not removed.
